recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Treat broader List-vs-FamilyMemberHistory guidance as separate future work only after a final decision on newer open trackers such as FHIR-32901.
issue_request: Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for a described way to record that family history for a relation was not collected or unavailable and resolving to add a FamilyHistory status with entered-in-error, complete/partial, and health-unknown concepts.
initial_application: Commit 1f59a1646f explicitly applied #5826, adding FamilyMemberHistory.status and the FamilyHistoryStatus code list while also applying FHIR-7483 condition-alignment work. The implemented code list used completed for the resolution's complete concept and included partial, entered-in-error, and health-unknown.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-13077 removed notDone and renamed notDoneReason to dataAbsentReason, clarifying that unavailable or unknown family-member history uses status=health-unknown. Later FHIR-8781/FHIR-8782 added notes for patient-level List.emptyReason and condition negation, and FHIR-55325 reaffirmed in R6 that status already includes health-unknown while adding note text. FHIR-32901 remains Triaged and does not supply a final source-edit decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source has mandatory FamilyMemberHistory.status with a required binding to history-status, the code system includes partial, completed, entered-in-error, and health-unknown, and narrative guidance documents health-unknown plus dataAbsentReason for unavailable history of an individual family member.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same 2015 commit as FHIR-5826 and explains adjacent condition-alignment edits.
Removed notDone and made dataAbsentReason the companion explanation when status is health-unknown.
R6 applied decision reaffirming that health-unknown is the status escape valve and adding note text.
Later published guidance for patient-level family history using List.emptyReason.
Later published guidance for no known problems or negated conditions for an individual family member.
Unresolved/Triaged request about broader List guidance, not a final source-edit decision.
